tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Chrome canvas: header, TOC sider and home page ground.

tokens.name: page
tokens.usage: The reading page: the chapter column, formulario and exercise lists sit on it. Warmer and lighter than `bg` in light, one step up in dark.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards on `bg` or `page`: exercise cards, formula blocks, book cards, the lab editor frame.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Fills inside a surface: hovered TOC rows, code output, table stripes, input fills, inline code.

tokens.name: surface-overlay
tokens.usage: Popovers (formula preview), dropdowns, modals, the mobile TOC drawer. Always with `shadow-overlay`.

tokens.name: border
tokens.usage: Hairlines: header and sider edges, card outlines, paragraph dividers. Decorative only.

tokens.name: border-control
tokens.usage: Outline of inputs, secondary buttons, reveal buttons and the dropzone (3:1 on every surface).

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Book text, headings and icons on `bg`, `page`, `surface`, `surface-raised`, `surface-overlay`.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: TOC paragraphs, captions, metadata, inactive section tabs. On every surface and soft fill.

tokens.name: ink-subtle
tokens.usage: Placeholders, paragraph numbers in the TOC, timestamps. 4.5:1 on every surface.

tokens.name: on-ink
tokens.usage: Text on an `ink` fill (tooltips in light, the inverse pill).

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Smartbook teal (ink-green): the one primary button, the selected chapter bar, the reading-progress fill, checked controls.

tokens.name: primary-hover
tokens.usage: Hover of `primary` fills.

tokens.name: primary-active
tokens.usage: Pressed `primary` fills.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Text and icons on `primary`, `primary-hover`, `primary-active`.

tokens.name: primary-text
tokens.usage: Links, cross-references (formula and chapter refs), the active section tab label and active TOC item, on surfaces and `primary-soft`.

tokens.name: primary-soft
tokens.usage: Active section tab, selected TOC row, formula-reference hover, formula number badge.

tokens.name: star
tokens.usage: Bookmark gold, shared with Pyxis: the ribbon in the logo, the current-paragraph marker in the TOC and rail, bookmarks. A mark, never body text in light.

tokens.name: star-text
tokens.usage: Gold text: hint labels, "licensed" badges, medium difficulty. On surfaces and `star-soft`.

tokens.name: star-soft
tokens.usage: Hint block background, licensed badge, search highlight.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Pyxis cobalt as text: the solution label and icon, "uploaded" badge, info notices. On surfaces and `info-soft`.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Solution block background, uploaded badge.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Text and marks for "easy" difficulty, a finished lab run, a valid import. Always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Background of success notices and the easy difficulty tag.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Hard difficulty, lab errors, failed imports, destructive actions. Always with an icon or word.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background of error output, failed-import notices and the hard difficulty tag.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: 2px solid focus outline, 2px offset, on every focusable element. Teal on light, gold on dark.

tokens.name: code-bg
tokens.usage: Code blocks and the lab editor gutter; `ink` code text on it.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Backdrop behind modals and the mobile TOC drawer.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Alias: links and cross-references in book text (underlined, 1px, offset 3px).

tokens.name: hint
tokens.usage: Alias: the hint label and lightbulb icon in RevealBlock.

tokens.name: solution
tokens.usage: Alias: the solution label and check icon in RevealBlock.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Alias: first plot series (GraphPanel), the function being studied.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Alias: second plot series (derivative, comparison curve).

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Alias: third series and the marked point on a plot. A mark, not text.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Alias: plot gridlines; axes use `border-control`.

families.mono: "JetBrains Mono", ui-monospace, "SF Mono", Menlo, Consolas, monospace

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Home page headline and empty states. Once per screen.

styles.name: title-1
styles.usage: Chapter title in ChapterHeader, section titles (Formulario, Esercizi, Laboratorio).

styles.name: title-2
styles.usage: Paragraph headings (`## p1 | Title`) with their mono number.

styles.name: title-3
styles.usage: Card titles: book cards, formula cards, lab cells, sub-headings inside a paragraph.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: La velocità media è il rapporto tra lo spazio percorso e il tempo impiegato a percorrerlo.
styles.usage: Chapter text, exercise questions. Max 68ch; paragraphs 0 0 `space-5`.

styles.name: reading-small
styles.sample: Ricorda che l'accelerazione è la derivata della velocità.
styles.usage: Hint and solution bodies, formula descriptions, text inside cards.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Figure captions and formula labels under a block.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Importa un file .ptsb per aggiungerlo alla libreria.
styles.usage: Default UI text: TOC chapters, forms, descriptions.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.usage: Buttons, the active TOC chapter, emphasised values.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: Metadata, TOC paragraphs, helper text, tag labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: UPPERCASE: section tabs, eyebrows (CAPITOLO 2, IN QUESTO CAPITOLO), hint/solution labels.

styles.name: meta
styles.usage: Numbers as data: formula numbers, exercise ids, paragraph numbers, file sizes.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Code blocks, the lab editor and its output.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in tags.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between buttons, tag padding-x, TOC row padding-y.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Small control padding-x, gap inside card headers.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Compact card padding, TOC padding-x, grid gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Button padding-x, space between reading paragraphs.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between exercise cards, page side padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Space above a paragraph heading, between page sections.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top padding of the reading column, space between paragraphs (`section`).

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Bottom padding before the chapter pager.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Tags, inline code, checkboxes, TOC rows.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Formula blocks, reveal blocks, figures, inputs inside cards, code cells.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards: exercise, book, formula card, graph panel.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Large panels: the import dropzone, modals.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons, section tabs, search fields, the formula reference chip. Actions are always pills.

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small buttons, header icon buttons, reveal buttons.

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, input and section-tab track height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: The chapter pager buttons and the home import call to action.

tokens.name: header-height
tokens.usage: Reader header (ProLayout header).

tokens.name: sider-width
tokens.usage: Chapter TOC sider; collapses to 0 below 1024px and moves into a drawer.

tokens.name: rail-width
tokens.usage: Right ParagraphRail; shown from 1280px.

tokens.name: reading-width
tokens.usage: Max width of the reading column (≈68ch of `reading`).

tokens.name: wide-width
tokens.usage: Max width for grids: formulario, exercises, lab, graphs, library.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Resting cards in light. Dark relies on surface steps and `border`.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Popovers (formula preview), dropdowns, modals, the TOC drawer.

tokens.name: shadow-header
tokens.usage: The sticky header once the page has scrolled.
